title: Prazosin and doxazosin for AUD, pre-registered sensitivity: the next outcome in the hierarchy where a trial posts two
intro: The same eight trials as alpha1_aud.json. Where a trial posts a second outcome from the hierarchy, it replaces the first: NCT00585780 and NCT02500602 use percent drinking days, NCT02322047 drinks per drinking day, NCT01518972 drinks per week. The other four trials post one drinking outcome and are unchanged.
